forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M376ER95A0C8N4KHFP9QS1JY
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8a80
+title: ToolCatalog and tool resolution with Claude semantics
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §5, the tool part. No `skills:` preload and no `maxTurns` limit here.
+
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tools/ToolCatalog.swift`: `public struct ToolCatalog: Sendable` holding `name → @Sendable () -> any Tool`. `register(_ name:_ factory:)`, `names`. Each call of a factory gives a new instance.
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tools/ToolResolver.swift`: `func resolve(tools: [ToolSpec]?, disallowed: [ToolSpec], catalog: ToolCatalog, agentsTool: (([String]?) -> any Tool)?) -> (tools: [any Tool], diagnostics: [AgentDiagnostic])`.
+  - No `tools` key gives the full catalog.
+  - `disallowedTools` applies first, then `tools`.
+  - `mcp__<server>`, `mcp__<server>__*`, `mcp__*` are prefix matches.
+  - An unknown name is a warning and is skipped. An unknown name in `disallowedTools` is a warning that sorts first in the list.
+  - `Agent` or `Agent(a, b)` gives the `agents` tool through the `agentsTool` closure, with the names limited to `a`, `b`. `agents` in the catalog follows the same rules.
+- Add the tool warnings to the catalog diagnostics through a function that the runner calls (`runner.catalog()` in a later task).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No `tools` gives all catalog tools; `tools: Read` gives only `Read`.
+- [ ] `disallowedTools: Read` with no `tools` removes `Read` from the full catalog.
+- [ ] Each MCP pattern matches the right names.
+- [ ] An unknown name in `tools` warns and is skipped; an unknown name in `disallowedTools` warns and is first.
+- [ ] Two resolves give two different tool instances.
+- [ ] `Agent(a, b)` calls the closure with `["a", "b"]`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/ToolResolverTests.swift` covers each criterion, and the `unknown-disallowed-tool.md` fixture.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter ToolResolverTests`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
